title: Zendaya Channels ‘Dune’ in a Glittering Sculptural Gown at the 2026 Governors Awards
text: Zendaya Wears a Vintage Sculptural Gown to the 2026 Governors Awards Subscribe Fashion Beauty Culture Horoscopes News & Politics In the Magazine Weddings Newsletter Follow Other Editions Your Privacy Choices Privacy Notice Terms Of Use Skip to Content Newsletter Subscribe Search Sign in Sign in Subscribe Newsletter Subscribe Search Fashion Beauty Culture Shopping News & Politics Horoscopes In the Magazine Video My Bookmarks Newsletter US Sign In Your Privacy Choices Privacy Notice Terms Of Use Fashion Beauty Culture Shopping News & Politics Horoscopes In the Magazine Video More Culture Celebrity News Zendaya Channels Dune in a Glittering Sculptural Gown at the 2026 Governors Awards Zendaya Channels Dune in a Glittering Sculptural Gown at the 2026 Governors Awards By Alyssa Bailey Published: Nov 15, 2026 10:04 PM EST Save Article Share Article Gilbert Flores // Getty Images 2 min read THE RUNDOWN Zendaya epitomized glamour at the Governors Awards in a glittering vintage Giles Deacon dress. She accessorized with a vintage Rolex watch and Chopard jewelry. The actress is currently promoting Dune: Part Three , the last of her five projects to come out this year. Zendaya is back on the awards show circuit in a glittering vintage gown meant to kick off her Dune: Part Three press tour. The actress attended this evening’s Governors Awards in a sculptural look from Giles Deacon’s fall/winter 2006 collection. She accessorized with a vintage Rolex watch and jewelry from Chopard. Michael Buckner // Getty Images Gilbert Flores // Getty Images Her stylist, Law Roach, wrote on Instagram that it’s her first Dune press tour look. The dress is even more stunning in motion: View full post on Instagram The star posed alone, though her husband, Tom Holland , was at the event, too. Gilbert Flores // Getty Images It marks her first awards show appearance since the Emmys in September, where she wore a glitzy Prada gown . Gilbert Flores // Getty Images Dune: Part Three is the last of Zendaya’s five projects to come out this year. She first promoted The Drama and Euphoria season 3 , which had April release dates, then The Odyssey and Spider-Man: Brand New Day , which debuted in July. In her ELLE Summer Issue cover story , she acknowledged it’s been a jam-packed 2026 with all the press tours. “It’s going to be a long year, but what’s great is that I’m really proud of everything. I just really love my job,” she said. “But I think that after this, I’m going to have to take a little bit of a break. [Though] as soon as I take a break, I start to go crazy. And I’m like, ‘I need to work.’” She also recalled filming all the projects and juggling the roles. “I remember being on set for Euphoria ; it was a night shoot at a ranch,” she said. “I was so tired, but I was also learning my Chakobsa lines for Dune . And then I started writing out my lines to memorize for that quick turnaround trip I was going to make to Iceland [for The Odyssey ]. It’s not like I have a lot of lines in The Odyssey , but I was working with Christopher Nolan! The most embarrassing thing in life would be messing up my lines, which did happen once.” The Odyssey director Christopher Nolan, meanwhile, had nothing but praise for Zendaya’s performance, telling ELLE, “We would be in the maddest, craziest situations, just all of us fighting the elements, tearing our hair out, all these things going on, and she would sort of parachute in from her other job with this sense of true grace and poise.” Watch Next   %0A%09%0A" width="60" height="60" alt="Play video"/> Advertisement - Continue Reading Below You Might Also Like Emma Watson Steps Out in Vintage Valentino Emma Watson Reveals Her Gala Dress’s Backstory Meghan Made a Subtle Change to Her Wedding Stack Beyoncé on Rumi Carter’s ‘Favorite Place to Shop’ Advertisement - Continue Reading Below Beyoncé Gives a Rare Look at Blue Ivy’s Style See Katy and Justin’s Rare Red Carpet Appearance Florence Pugh Won’t Let Fear Hold Her Back Zendaya Reveals Tom Holland’s Sweet Set Support Hailey Bieber Kicks Off Her 30th Birthday The Diplomat Season 4 Finale Is So Surprising" data-vars-ga-outbound-link="https://www.elle.com/culture/movies-tv/a74160470/the-diplomat-season-4-finale-ending-explained/" data-vars-ga-ux-element="Transporter" href="/culture/movies-tv/a74160470/the-diplomat-season-4-finale-ending-explained/" class="e1su9sit0 css-m8pdf0 enrmkiw0"> Why The Diplomat Season 4 Finale Is So Surprising Kate Middleton Gives a Rare Look at Natural Hair Is Taylor Swift at the Chiefs-Falcons Game?
